features.title: Everything you need to run a modern studio
features.subtitle: From solo coach to multi-location organisation, Linyup adapts to the way you work.
features.moreSubtitle: Tap any feature to see how it works.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.detail: Build your weekly timetable in minutes — recurring classes, capacity limits, and attendance, all in one calendar.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: See your whole week at a glance.
calendar.detail: Your entire studio's week in one colour-coded view, by activity and instructor — never double-book a room again.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Every student profile in one place.
contacts.detail: A complete profile for every student — notes, history, ranks, and membership status, always a click away.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.detail: Students reserve their spot in a tap and you get a clean, real-time roster for every single session.

checkins.title: Check-ins
checkins.description: Fast QR check-in at the door.
checkins.detail: Check students in with a quick scan — no clipboards, no spreadsheets, just an accurate attendance record.

trials.title: Trials
trials.detail: Capture every trial sign-up and nudge them toward membership with built-in follow-ups that convert.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.detail: Sell monthly, quarterly, or annual plans and track every renewal automatically — no spreadsheet required.

payments.title: Payments
payments.detail: Connect your payment provider and let dues collect themselves — say goodbye to chasing late payments.

biolink.title: Bio link
biolink.description: One link for everything you offer.
biolink.detail: One shareable link with your schedule, booking, and sign-up — perfect for your Instagram or TikTok bio.

website.title: Website
website.description: A booking site, ready out of the box.
website.detail: Launch a polished studio website with your schedule and pricing built in — no designer, no code.

mobileApp.title: Mobile app
mobileApp.description: iOS & Android app for your students.
mobileApp.detail: Your students get a branded iOS and Android app to book, check in, and stay in the loop wherever they are.

automations.title: Automations
automations.detail: Set it once and let Linyup welcome new members, send reminders, and win back lapsed ones — automatically.

gamification.title: Gamification
gamification.detail: Points, streaks, and badges that turn simply showing up into a habit your students genuinely love.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.detail: Track belts, levels, and leaderboards that keep members chasing their next milestone — and coming back.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.detail: Reward members for bringing friends, with referrals tracked and credited automatically. Your best growth channel.

courses.title: Courses
courses.detail: Package your expertise into multi-week online courses your members can buy and follow at their own pace.

events.title: Events
events.detail: Run competitions, camps, gradings, and workshops with sign-ups, invitations, and check-in all built in.

eventForms.title: Event forms
eventForms.detail: Collect exactly the information you need at sign-up with fully custom fields for every event type.

groups.title: Groups
groups.detail: Organise members into squads, levels, or committees for targeted communication and effortless management.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.description: Track exactly the data you need.
customFields.detail: Add the fields your studio actually needs and track any data on any contact — your CRM, your rules.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.detail: See attendance, retention, and engagement trends so you always know what's working — and what needs attention.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Reach students where they already are.
whatsapp.detail: Send reminders, updates, and re-engagement messages on WhatsApp, right where your students already are.

aiInsights.title: AI insights
aiInsights.description: Spot churn risk before it happens.
aiInsights.detail: Let AI flag members at risk of leaving and even draft the perfect message to win them back before they're gone.

team.title: Team & roles
team.detail: Invite coaches and managers with the right permissions for each role — everyone sees exactly what they should.

migration.title: We migrate your data for you
migration.subtitle: Moving from another tool is the worst part of switching — so leave it to us. We bring over your contacts, schedule, memberships and history. You just review the result and tell us what to adjust.
migration.badge: Free white-glove migration for early adopters

send.title: Send us your data
send.detail: An export or spreadsheet from your current tool — whatever you already have.

migrate.title: We do the heavy lifting
migrate.detail: We map and import your contacts, schedule, memberships and history into Linyup.

review.title: You review & instruct
review.detail: Check the result and just tell us what to adjust. Nothing goes live until it's right.

plans.title: Plans for every stage
plans.subtitle: Simple plans that scale with you.

plans.migrationNote: Switching platforms? We migrate your data for you — free.
